role: TroubleshootingPage struct: consumer problem/crash read-outs, and (behind Advanced Diagnostics) keyboard capture, archive read health, AI cache telemetry, prompt audit, pre-score and usage telemetry; plus the reanalysis/repair worker methods.
state: mem:TroubleshootingPage @State: logCopiedConfirmation, crashReportCleared, showingTrainingRepairAlert, showingTrainingRepairConfirm, trainingRepairMessage, isRepairingTraining, isRebuildingLoad, trainingRepairProgress/Total, isReanalyzing, reanalyzeMessage, showingReanalyzeAlert, reanalyzeStopped, reanalyzeProgress/Total, reanalyzeTask, showingReanalyzeConfirm, reanalyzeDateRange, reanalyzeFromDate (now − 2 weeks), reanalyzeToDate (now)
toplevel: @State initializers: reanalyzeFromDate = now minus 2 weeks (?? now), reanalyzeToDate = now, evaluated when the view value is created. reanalyzeTask is not cancelled when the page is dismissed, so a running reanalysis continues in the background.
